entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I need to ask about a return. I feel so bad for even calling, it's been a while since I bought them.
Not a problem at all, I'm here to help. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Garcia, order number 774-2198B. It's for the cycling shoes I bought back in October.
Okay, I see the order right here, Maria. You'd like to return the cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I tried so hard to love them. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years. But they just... they gave me the worst blisters, right on my heel. I tried different socks, adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but nothing worked. It's just been a painful experience.
I'm very sorry to hear that, Maria. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the purchase date and review our policy for you. One moment.
Okay. I know it's been a while. With the holidays and everything... I just really was hoping I could get the money back. Things are a bit tight.

I understand completely. Okay, I've reviewed your order. It looks like you received the shoes 78 days ago. According to our policy for this item, you're still well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful news. I was so worried I'd just wasted all that money. Thank you so much, Alex.

You're very welcome, Maria. I'm happy we could sort this out. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return label. Just pack the shoes in a box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Does that sound good?
That sounds perfect. You've really helped me out today. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Have a great day!
You too, Maria. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and goodbye.
